purpose: Establish whether the existing trusted 2160p Hallowed x265 fallback is good enough relative to credible same-master UHD reference material (Remux / transparent master), then measure how much additional loss AV1 introduces relative to that accepted baseline.
acceptance_premise: Hallowed 2160p x265 is an accepted practical quality baseline for this library. AV1 is evaluated by whether it is materially worse than that baseline in high-risk conditions (shadow detail, dark gradients, smoke, 35mm grain, dust, texture, motion), not against a universal VMAF threshold.
guardrails: Evidence-only. Zero modifications to active tiers, profile scores, Custom Formats, release restrictions, verdicts.csv, or live automation.
